Electric range that matches the flagship's long-distance role

Proposal
1, implement. Electric range is level A (45 rows, 17 wishes for 350 to 400 miles); winter range below 150 miles is reported, and fuel economy scores 4.99 vs 5.48.
Horizon
H2. Needs the next battery generation.
Domain
Powertrain, Range & Charging
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-PR-02 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

The successor of the i7 shall offer a real-world range that covers long US highway stages in cold weather without range anxiety.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USEPA range of the BEV>= 350 miHomologationassumption
USRange at -7 °C>= 75 % of EPA rangeCold-weather testassumption

    Customers of the BMW 7 Series (US) raise 45 complaint rows about 'Electric Range' (0 defects, 28 usability problems, 17 wishes) from 4 source type(s); that is 1.8% of all complaint rows in this market and 69% of what customers say about this theme.

    Figures. 65 rows: 20 likes, 45 complaints (0 defects, 28 difficult to use, 17 wants). 1.8 % of the market's 2,498 complaint rows; 69% of the theme's rows are complaints. by powertrain: BEV 54, PHEV 11. by source: Source B 41, Source A 17, Source C 6, Source D 1. by country: US 65.
